A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Elom system/Legends|Elom system]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], in either [[3961 BBY|3961]] or [[3960 BBY]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and the [[Revanchist]]s lead the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces in a counter-offensive against the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]. This brought them through the [[Stenos system/Legends|Stenos system]], where they [[Battle of the Stenos system|defeated]] the Mandalorians, to the Elom system, where they were also victorious. From Elom, they attacked [[Jaga's Cluster/Legends|Jaga's Cluster]] and were [[Battle of Jaga's Cluster|soundly defeated]].

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It is marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the battles of the Mandalorian Wars rather than described in prose.
